overview: Filmed over 2 years in Emerald Park, this full access behind-the-scenes series follows the trials & tribulations of building Europe's longest intertwining family & thrillcoasters.
title: Nerves of Steel

overview: Explore the Tudor-Stuart era: a captivating examination of the 229-year period from 1485-1714 during which England transformed itself from a minor feudal state into what has been called the first modern society. Award-winning Professor Robert Bucholz of Loyola University of Chicago presents a sweeping, 48-episode series on one of the most intriguing times in modern history.
title: History of England from the Tudors to the Stuarts

overview: Ten years after the tragic death of her son Esteban, Maddi meets Tom, a young boy who looks uncannily like him. Intrigued, she moves from her native Basque Country to be closer to Tom in Auvergne. She quickly discovers that in addition to the physical resemblance, Tom has flashbacks and visions of Esteban's memories. When a series of murders rocks the peaceful region, Maddi can't help but wonder: are these events connected to her son's death? Who is Tom really, and what is his connection to Esteban?
title: Rien ne t'efface

overview: At the outset of the Cold War, the USSR launched a secret surveillance mission on a scale the world had never seen. Soviet spies were tasked with mapping the entire globe. From eyes in the sky, to boots on the ground. They stalked the shadows behind enemy lines. Their records of buildings, transportation networks, power grids, and factories would generate over a million highly classified maps. Now, only 30 years out from the close of the Cold War, many strange missions are coming to light. Could finding the links between this monstrous resource, and other covert ops be the key to uncovering old plans of world domination?
title: A Cold War of Spies

overview: Friends Gosha, Tolya, Dmitry and Oleg are exemplary womanizers. Women for them are a measure of the ambitions of a man's wealth and self-confidence. Although both real passion and true feeling are not alien to them. In a series of endless romances, they can truly fall in love. True, the objects of their feelings sometimes turn out to be practically unattainable.
title: Холостяки

overview: The story of a modern Cinderella. Young Vika managed not only to become the subject of ridicule from the first beauties of the school, but also to fall in love with the most arrogant, spoiled boy, the son of an oligarch...
title: Школа № 1

overview: Sarankhe (Russian: Саранхэ) is a game for couples in love for money. In each episode, the participants - a young man and a girl - will have to, without saying a word, answer questions about each other's habits, shortcomings and interests in the same way. In total, the heroes will be asked 10 questions. Each correct answer increases the prize fund by 10,000 rubles. At the end, lovers will be invited to play a super game. 3 super questions can increase your winnings 3 times!
title: Саранхэ

overview: Dive into The Brighter Side, a show that will help you make the most of your money with practical tips and big ideas. Hosted by Georgie Tunny, you'll discover how to make the most of today while planning for tomorrow. We ask well-known Australians for their two cents on making the most of life. Personal finance expert Jess Irvine helps people consider new ways to handle their financial pressures; Adam Liaw cooks his most delicious and affordable family meals; and Narelda Jacobs meets Australians with side hustles and homes that alleviate hip pocket pressure in clever ways. We're feeling brighter already.
title: The Brighter Side

overview: Reports and investigations by journalists and presenter Alexei Lysenkov of phenomena and facts that are difficult to explain.
title: Истина где-то рядом

overview: Following day-to-day life at Addenbrooke's Hospital, renowned for its cutting-edge support for patients seeking treatment or surgery for conditions that affect the face and neck.
title: The Face Doctors

overview: Tony Armstrong unfolds his bike and hits the road to learn about the untold history of Australia. He travels the length and breadth of the country to meet Aussies with ordinary things that hold extra-ordinary stories.
title: Tony Armstrong's Extra-Ordinary Things

overview: Suspecting infidelity, Zoleka plans to catch her boyfriend in the act, only to ruin her own surprise proposal. Now she must win him back.
title: How to Ruin Love

overview: Oslo fengsel (Oslo prison) is one of Norway's largest prisons. In this documentary series, we follow both employees and inmates in life behind bars.
title: Oslo Fengsel

overview: Lidia Curanaj reveals Washington's inner workings and the fight for core values.
title: Sunday Agenda

overview: When a young girl goes missing on her way to the Mayday parade, the small community in which she lives looks to one another for answers. But beneath the picture-postcard idyll lies a sinister other world and the dark woods teem with myth. As the community reels from Hattie's disappearance, the drama follows the mass hysteria and ensuing search from the point of view of the central characters, each of whom fears that someone they know is responsible. As they keep silent, their suspicions intensify over the course of the five episodes.
title: Mayday

overview: Rob Schmitt Tonight locks in all the late-breaking stories that matter to you, and delivers the up-to-the-minute news you need to hear before turning in.
title: Rob Schmitt Tonight

overview: Eric Bolling The Balance helps make sense of the day's biggest headlines from DC, Wall Street, and the world…and how those headlines affect the people on Main Street.
title: Eric Bolling The Balance

overview: The hardest-hitting stories from coast to coast: We take you from the Beltway to the Rust Belt and beyond — never forgetting we're here to enlighten, expose, inform, and spotlight the stories that matter to you.
title: Greg Kelly Reports

overview: Greg Kelly provides hard-hitting reports and analysis from Los Angeles to New York and the Beltway to the Rust Belt. Saturdays @ 4:00 PM Sundays @ 5:00 PM
title: Greg Kelly This Week

overview: Chris Plante and his "THE RIGHT SQUAD" are the most interesting, informative and funny group of talking heads in the world! It's a big claim. But it's true!
title: Chris Plante: The Right Squad

overview: "The Chris Salcedo Show" features your conservative, liberty-loving host, who confronts the biased press, both political parties, and the extremist left — every day.
title: The Chris Salcedo Show

overview: Carl Higbie Frontline focuses on providing commonsense news analysis, exposing big government overreach and the media's shortfalls — all while always fighting for American values. Produced from Newsmax's Manhattan studios covering breaking news and exploring key issues such as personal liberty, security, and government transparency.
title: Carl Higbie Frontline

overview: Bianca de la Garza tackles the big news from D.C., N.Y., across America, and around the world!
title: Bianca Across the Nation

overview: American Agenda with hosts Bob Brooks & Katrina Szish is a live, fast-paced look at national news and international events. The program brings viewers the latest from Washington, with insightful analysis from lawmakers and experts, and media reports from New York and around the globe.
title: American Agenda

overview: Tom Basile tackles the week's biggest stories with top talkers from politics, Hollywood, and across America.
title: America Right Now

overview: The story, told over three 60-minute episodes, begins when a wave of violence hits London following the discovery of the bizarrely mutilated body of a man in the Thames. First appearances suggest a witchcraft killing. But the dark reality is more complicated – and even more frightening. Assigned to the case is young, hopeful DS Dan Twentyman (Matt Smith) and his senior partner DI Moses Jones (Shaun Parkes), seconded from Scotland Yard due to cultural links with the local community.
title: Moses Jones

overview: Rita Cosby and Jon Glasgow tackles the big headlines with smart analysis from top experts.
title: Saturday Report

overview: Veteran broadcaster Wendy Bell takes a deep dive into tough issues with guests from across the country.
title: Wendy Bell Common Sense

overview: Dick Morris breaks down top political news, bringing a keen perspective to make our democracy stronger and better.
title: Dick Morris Democracy

overview: Radio talk show host Mark Kaye takes on big media, big government and big PC, with a few laughs too.
title: The Mark Kaye Show

overview: Rob Carson dissects politics, cultural phenomena and absurdity confronting us every day in America with humor and satire.
title: Rob Carson's What in the World?

overview: Sit down with Nancy Brinker, founder of the Susan G. Komen Race for the Cure, as she talks to some of the nation's most powerful and influential personalities.
title: Conversations with Nancy Brinker

overview: Every Sunday, Dr. Gorka is unafraid to challenge to politicos and newsmakers, hitting back hard against legacy media, Big Tech, and the Washington Swamp.
title: The Gorka Reality Check

overview: Extracted features 12 untrained competitors attempting to survive extremely grueling conditions, perilous terrain, and the threat of fearsome predators in the unforgiving Canadian wilderness. Meanwhile, some miles away, their family members are locked down at a secluded headquarters watching them navigate their dangerous surroundings alone via a 24/7 live feed. The fate of each untrained contestant in the wilderness lies in the hands of their family members back in HQ. Each amateur survivalist's family has the power to decide whether their loved one has what it takes to brave the elements and fight to be the last one standing, or whether the family will push the ominous "Extract" button and remove their loved one and their whole family from the competition. Extracted begs the question: how far will their loved ones let them go for a chance for their family to win $250,000?
title: Extracted

overview: E-Jae's mum has a boarder move into their house, Woori. Soon after, they become girlfriends and start a YouTube channel.
title: To the X Who Hated Me

overview: From the inception of the universe, Narayan was given the responsibility of being the divine force looking after it. While Goddess Lakshmi was responsible for the happiness and well-being of the creatures inhabiting this universe. Lakshmi Narayan is an endless saga of love, devotion and divinity of Lord Vishnu and Goddess Lakshmi.
title: Lakshmi Narayan

overview: The tie is simple: one fine day, as usual, absolutely unexpectedly, to Andrey there comes his very distant relative (according to the most conservative estimates, the second cousin) Ivan and directly from a threshold declares that he intends to live at the beloved brother. He isn't a speculator, and simply very cheerful and absolutely naive young man. In mountains Ivan worked as the shepherd in collective farm for himself. But, escaping from the marriage imposed by the father, I decided to run where far away. And it appeared in Moscow. Here the self-confident and purposeful mountaineer decides that came it is time to open all the abilities. Brothers start living in one apartment and together work in antique shop. All this also makes a basis for a sitcom – a difference of city and natural perception of life, specifics of national mentality, household sharpness of Ivan and Andrey's not skill. Together heroes get out of humorously difficult situations which, often, and generated. The role of the negative character at the very beginning of development of history in series is played by "the Moscow jerk" Arkady Mikhaylovich – the director of shop where Andrey and Ivan work. Recognition of situations, sympathy to position of the gawk provincial in the megalopolis, charm of the main characters, natural humour of Ivan, Andrey's irony will make these series interesting to a wide range of the audience.
title: Братья по-разному

overview: Krishna Mohini is a poignant drama set in the holy land of Dwarka, India, following the journey of twenty-one-year-old Krishna, a gifted singer and sole breadwinner for her family. As she navigates life's challenges, including her brother Mohan's struggle with gender identity, Krishna must confront societal norms and prejudices while striving to protect and support her loved ones. With themes of identity, family, and resilience, Krishna Mohini sheds light on the often-overlooked issues facing the transgender community in India.
title: Krishna Mohini

overview: As a single mother, Janvi's life revolves around her son, Kian. Aryaman shares a strained relationship with his father but develops a bond with Kian. Will he fill the void in Janvi and Kian's lives?
title: Main Hoon Saath Tere

overview: Mangal Lakshmi is a heartwarming tale that centers around the bond between two sisters, Mangal and Lakshmi. As Mangal navigates through life's experiences, she embarks on a journey to find the perfect dulha for her beloved sister, Lakshmi. Through love, trials, and determination, Mangal's quest unfolds, showcasing the enduring strength of sisterhood and the power of destiny in bringing two souls together.
title: Mangal Lakshmi

overview: TV and radio veteran Larry King hosts this interview show in which he talks to guests from the entertainment world or people who are in the headlines. King often welcomes callers from around the U.S. to phone in with their own queries, usually referring to callers only by location, not by name.
title: Larry King Live

overview: John Tabacco and his crew look at the big issues, shining a light on hypocrisy and dangerous policies of the elites.
title: Wise Guys with John Tabacco

overview: Jon Glasgow tackles the big headlines with smart analysis from top experts.
title: Sunday Report

overview: Bianca de la Garza looks at the big stories of the week, politics, policy, the economy, and much more!
title: Newsmax News In-Depth

overview: Find today's news headlines and the best in conservative commentary from Newsmax.com. Our stories cover a wide range of current events.
title: Newsfront

overview: Ashleigh Banfield joins NewsNation with a news and talk show airing weeknights.
title: Banfield

overview: In-depth coverage of the biggest news stories of the day; NewsNation's home for exclusive and enterprise reporting; hosted live by Elizabeth Vargas.
title: Elizabeth Vargas Reports

overview: The day's hottest subjects.
title: On Balance with Leland Vittert

overview: A remarkable team of detectives use DNA to re-investigate unsolved sexual offences dating back to the 1980s. Can they find the offenders and finally get justice for their victims?
title: Cold Case Investigators: Solving Britain's Sex Crimes

overview: A powerful spear said to make its wielder invincible. A gilded wooden box thought capable of laying waste to enemies. A treasured cup believed to have miraculous healing abilities. For centuries, there have been possessions, weapons, places, and even human bones considered to be precious mystical objects. These one-of-a-kind wonders are revered by cultures all around the world, and have been sought after by everyone from emperors, popes and tyrants, to generals, archaeologists, and treasure hunters. Holy Marvels with Dennis Quaid is an exciting new series that digs deep into the remarkable stories behind these awe-inspiring artifacts, their creation, the mysteries of their incredible powers, and the unforgettable adventures to find them.
title: Holy Marvels with Dennis Quaid

overview: Series telling the story of a man in a Glasgow hospital who awoke from a Covid coma to discover that the police had identified him as a fugitive from justice and one of America's most wanted criminals. He maintained that this was a case of mistaken identity - but was he an extraordinary criminal, constantly changing his name and identity, or a wronged innocent thrown into a limelight he did not deserve?
title: Imposter: The Man Who Came Back from the Dead

overview: A singer, a dancer, and a comic, all show-business unknowns, play themselves onstage and off in this combination sitcom and variety show from Gary Smith and Dwight Hemion.
title: 3 Girls 3

overview: The characters of the series are people of different ages, social status, and material wealth. They have one thing in common - the difficult life situation in which they find themselves. Practicing psychic Arina Evdokimova uses her abilities to understand the problem, "open the eyes" of the characters to the real state of affairs, guide them, and suggest behavioral tactics to improve the situation. The abilities of a psychic and the skills of a psychologist help her to simultaneously "look" into the past and future of the heroes, formulate special tasks, after which the fate of the heroes changes for the better...
title: Ясновидящая

overview: The idea of the program is simple: to restore the image of a real person using virtual traces left on the Internet by an unknown user. And if you still think that no one sees your faces online, doesn't know your age, place of work or credit history, then you absolutely need to watch the program! During the game, with the help of the presenter's tricky questions, four valiant experts refute naive misconceptions about the confidentiality of our data on the Internet.
title: IDетектив

overview: Often labelled as 'Miss Average', Sajeeri finds love in the perfectionist Shivam. But as feelings remain one-sided, will she ever find her shot at true love?
title: Meetha Khatta Pyaar Hamara

overview: A dreamy-eyed Sayali yearns for her prince charming. But when destiny ties her with hero-cum-thug Sachin, will her hopes for a fairytale life prevail?
title: Udne Ki Aasha

overview: This is the story of the king of kings, the knower of all, the mighty Pracchand Ashok. Watch how he builds his legacy while realising that once you become the owner of everything, you are left with nothing.
title: Pracchand Ashok

overview: Forget about athletes, movie stars and politicians. Parents are the real heroes - but we think Frankie Heck, must be some kind of superhero. A loving wife and mother of three, she's middle class in the middle of the country and is rapidly approaching middle age. Frankie and her husband, Mike, have lived in Orson, Indiana, their whole lives. A man of few words (every one a zinger), Mike is a manager at the town quarry and Frankie is the third-best used car salesman (out of the three) at the local dealership. She may not be a high-powered career woman, but when it comes to her family, she'll go to just about any length. And with kids like these, she had better. There's Axl, her semi-nudist teenage son conceived while under the influence of Guns N' Roses; Sue, the awkward teenage daughter who fails at everything... but with the utmost of gusto; and their seven-year-old son Brick, whose best friend is his backpack. Sometimes it seems like everyone is trying to get to the top, or struggling not to hit bottom, but we think Frankie and her family will find a lot of love, and a lot of laughs, somewhere in The Middle.
title: The Middle

overview: Private Practice is the story of a team of gifted doctors working together to change the lives of their patients for the better as they look to one another for friendship and love. The doctors of Seaside Health and Wellness work on the most difficult cases, patients whose medical needs often pose moral and ethical dilemmas. Though they may heatedly disagree at work, and their personal lives may complicate matters, at the end of the day, they are the best of friends, always ready to be there for one another.
title: Private Practice

overview: Seihou Private High School, also known as Alcatraz, is a 35-year-old prestigious boarding high school. The school is located on a remote island and can only be visited by boat twice a day and almost impossible by foot. The environment seems perfect for school as students cannot do anything except concentrating on their studies. However, a group of friends became upset that they will be losing their youths and try to get away and find freedom. Adapted from the manga "Seiho High School Men's!!!" (メンズ校) by Izumi Kaneyoshi (和泉かねよし)
title: Men's Kou

overview: A pariah detective is pulled back into the game after his daughter's friend goes missing. The latest in a long line of women to go missing in the Gangnam area of Seoul, the detective delves back into a world of vice, drugs and corruption to uncover something that threatens to topple some of the city's wealthiest elite.
title: Gangnam B-Side

overview: Two CA Aspirants from two different ends of the spectrum of the course, Archie and Niraj embark on the journey of one of the toughest courses and face the obstacles it has to offer.
title: Half CA

overview: Spider-Noir tells the story of Ben Reilly, a seasoned, down on his luck private investigator in 1930s New York, who is forced to grapple with his past life, following a deeply personal tragedy, as the city's one and only superhero.
title: Spider-Noir

overview: After a dreamy and 'oh-so-happening' America visit, Anupama returns home. With new challenges and old conflicts to resolve, a new journey awaits her.
title: Anupama

overview: Host Dan Abrams brings a fresh, no-holds-barred approach to covering and analyzing the news weeknights.
title: Dan Abrams Live

overview: The game involves two teams of two people. The game consists of three rounds and a super final for the winning team. Players answer questions related to the years. The team that earns the most money wins.
title: Назад в будущее

overview: Voja Nanovič, the original screenwriter, connected the action of the series as a sublimation of all the novels and short stories of Bora Stankovič into one family saga covering a period of 40 years from the end of the 19th century. Through three generations, Unclean Blood tells the story of the financial, moral and physical decline of a family. The story begins with Hadži Trifun, Sofka's grandfather, and ends with Sofka, i.e. all the characters from Tašana, Paraputa and other works are connected through that one family and people who lived in Vranje. Tryphon, a wealthy leader of the Christian minority in the Turkish Empire, represents the first generation of the family. He tries to meet the moral standards of society and preserve his wealth and his family's reputation, while at the same time fighting against his erotic urges. In order to maintain his power, Tryphon sets in motion a series of events that will have dire consequences for his family members. The second generation of the family is represented by Mita, Tryfun's son, who does not want to be part of his father's dirty business empire. Mita belongs to a group of old aristocrats, whose resources are drying up and who are opposed by new, rich profiteers, uneducated and vulgar. After losing all his wealth and possessions, Mita is forced to marry his most beautiful daughter, Sofka, to a rich man in order to survive. Sofka represents the third generation of the family, which is under complete financial and spiritual decline. Despite being marked by the blood and actions of her ancestors, Sofka tries to rise above the social and historical circumstances of the time in which she lives.
title: Nečista krv

overview: Before his death, Zhanbyrbai ata, the elder of the village, a wayward and stubborn grandfather, bequeathed to his second cousins, who had never seen him in their lives, a house, a cow, the dog Aktos and 100 million tenge. The grandchildren will receive a huge inheritance under one condition - they need to live in the village for exactly a year, without leaving its territory for more than 24 hours. In case of an error, all money will be transferred to the account of the local akimat.
title: Внуки в ауле

overview: What is the daily routine like for an ambulance crew? Viewers can expect an honest and witty story about those who save the lives of Kazakhstanis every day, demonstrating sparkling humor and the ability not to lose heart even in those life situations where there is usually no time for laughter. The characters of the sitcom are a driver, a paramedic and his assistant. Each of them has their own problems and dreams. But their main calling: the ability to quickly make decisions when minutes count.

Plastic surgeon Dr. Sydney Hansen returns to her hometown of Providence, Rhode Island, to attend her pregnant sister Joanie's wedding, but realizes that her emotionally distant veterinarian father, her rascal of a baby brother and her high maintenance sister need her more than her glitzy Beverly Hills patients. In Providence, Sydney finds work in a low-income medical clinic.
title: Providence

overview: The focus is on Marat. He is the most ordinary young man, born and raised in Kazakhstan. Like each of us, he dreams of something and makes plans for the future. Most of all, Marat wants to get settled in life: find a well-paid job, meet the girl of his dreams, marry her, start a strong family. This is how Marat sees the life of an accomplished person. It is not known whether the prospect of teaching at the university was part of Marat's plans, but he still got a job at a higher education institution. Here he met a huge number of new people. Colleagues gradually turn into friends of the newcomer. Life turns upside down. Everything seems to start from scratch...
title: Преподы

overview: Elle follows Elle Woods in high school as we learn about the life experiences that shaped her into the iconic young woman we came to know and love in the first Legally Blonde film.
title: Elle

overview: JB Smoove hosts a business competition where entrepreneurs get 90 seconds to pitch their product to an audience of potential customers: The 100. If The 100 like the product and price, then the entrepreneurs go to a panel of Amazon executives and celebrity entrepreneurs. The panel selects which products join Amazon's exclusive Buy It Now Store and award one entrepreneur $20,000 each episode.
title: Buy It Now

overview: Wish List Games is a multi-episode holiday event. Joining Emmy-winner and host Nick Cannon, content creator Lele Pons will be featured on the game show as a special correspondent. Wish List Games is a high-energy, half-hour game show where contestants play for the chance to win everything on their Amazon Wish List, totaling up to $25,000. Every episode, contestants are pulled from the audience to play a rotating series of fun and fantastical games. It all builds to the final round, where one contestant plays to win a prize for everyone in the audience.
title: Wish List Games

overview: Anderson Cooper anchors this show that provides the news in a fun and interactive ways as viewers get to engage and have a say in the stories that are covered.
title: Anderson Cooper Full Circle

overview: 5 Things brings you the five essential stories that — in five minutes or less — will get you up to speed and on with your day. Stream itlive or anytime, only on CNN Max.
title: 5 Things with Kate Bolduan

overview: Pop Culture Jeopardy! is a brand-new twist on the classic quiz show's "answer-and-question" format that combines the academic rigor of Jeopardy! with the excitement and unpredictability of pop culture. Contestants, playing in teams of three, will need to be experts in categories from Alternative Rock to The Avengers; Broadway to MMA; Gen Z to Zendaya as they compete in a tournament-style event for the grand prize and ultimate bragging rights.
title: Pop Culture Jeopardy!

overview: CNN Anchor Wolf Blitzer gives it to you straight, hitting the headlines you need to know on this traditional evening newscast with a sleek, modern twist. The old-school nostalgic approach featuring original reporting from around the world, investigations and consumer focused stories that matter helps put the latest headlines in perspective.
title: The Newscast with Wolf Blitzer

overview: Malcolm McGee (Malcolm-Jamal Warner) is a responsible and sensible 20-something who ends up sharing a Kansas City apartment and a business venture with relentlessly enthusiastic tow truck owner Eddie Sherman (Eddie Griffin). A fast talker with outlandish frenetic energy, Eddie's charming schemes always seems to get the two into hot water. But no matter what the situation, these opposites always end up bailing each other out -- even if they drive each other crazy.
title: Malcolm & Eddie

overview: Based on the podcast of the same name, Scamanda tells the story of Amanda Riley — a wife, mother, blogger and Christian — whose tragic cancer tale captivates thousands. But Amanda has a secret that she's dying to keep, and after an anonymous tip to an investigative reporter, her own words may prove to be her downfall.
title: Scamanda

overview: New dad, Anderson Cooper gets parenting advice from experts as he navigates life as a working parent. Anderson confronts everyday challenges from sleep schedules to screen time to audience questions about relatable daily struggles.
title: Parental Guidance with Anderson Cooper

overview: El Gato Aguirre, a professional soccer player, who has to abandoned his successful career because of a car accident, he has to go back to the neighborhood that saw him grow as a man and as a soccer player; to dedicate himself to form young soccer players in a soccer school and to succeed with them. In this we find also that Lucia and her son Pablo play and important part. She is a woman, affected by the kidnap and disappearance of her husband, keeps her in a difficult economical and sentimental situation. Pablo, on the other hand, is young, happy, anxious, talented and with a noticeable ability to elude contraries in the soccer field and the reprimands at home. For one of those things in life and soccer, El Gato arrives to live with Lucia and Pablo, to provide us with the more exciting of the impossible loves, and the most amusing encounters. In the middle of the games is Willington Ortiz, a true Latin-American soccer legend who becomes the best friend, counselor, and master of El Gato and its pupils.
title: De pies a Cabeza

overview: Read between the lines with Tapper as he interviews newsmaking authors and a few of his favorite writers. Each week, viewers learn about the stories behind bestselling books and add more to their reading lists along the way.
title: Jake Tapper's Book Club

overview: He's celebrated the highs of NBA stardom, rebounded from the lows of opioid addiction, and reinvented himself through social media. If anyone can find the silver lining in today's toughest headlines, it's Rex Chapman. He brings heart and positivity to conversations with celebrities, athletes and everyday heroes.
title: Rex Chapman

overview: Make your voice heard in Don's weekly talk show as he and his special guests break down the buzziest moments and debate the most provocative stories of the week.
title: The Don Lemon Show

overview: What does it take to be the boss? Poppy Harlow gets the answers from the biggest names in business. Sit in on intimate conversations and confessions from today's most influential leaders and learn how personal and professional struggles helped them forge a path to success.
title: Boss Files with Poppy Harlow

overview: An in-depth look at the most important and interesting story of the day, hosted by Sara Sidner. Sidner hosts a deep-dive conversation featuring reporters and expert guests. Zoom out and contemplate the broader scope of today's top story and how various pieces of the puzzle connect.
title: Big Picture with Sara Sidner

overview: Teresa Suárez, nicknamed "Gaviota" (Spanish for "Gull"), and her mother Carmenza Suárez, work as harvesters and throughout the year they travel to different farmlands across Colombia searching for work. One, October Gaviota meets Sebastián Vallejo, the grandson of the owner of the farmlands where they work. They fall deeply in love with each other and plan to be together even if it means going against his family's will, but eventually destiny separates them and they must overcome many obstacles to find their way back together.
title: Café

overview: This series that initially takes place in 1920 tells the story of the deep and eternal love between Rosa Lenoit "La Momposina" and Alejandro Molinares, as well as the confrontation between their two cities, Santa Cruz de Mompos and Nuestra Señora de La Candelaria del Banco, both located on the banks of the Magdalena River in the Colombian tropics. Without meeting Alejandro yet, in Mompos, Rosa is pressured by her parents to accept Captain Rito Perilla as a boyfriend, a man much older than her who is truly in love and has also promised the girl's father, General Trinidad Lenoit, settle in this port with his steamboat company if she becomes his wife. On the other hand, at the Bank, Alejandro's father, "El Galeno" Molinares, a man with great vision, insists on turning his population into the most advanced of his time in the country, always wanting to overshadow the successes of the Lenoit family. To this end, he builds a theater to represent opera, and associates with the German Hindenbur to bring a seaplane and thus inaugurate the first aviation company in the country. Alejandro, for his part, only observes the activities of his father without paying much attention to them. His job is to make all the women of the town fall in love and go from party to party with his friends. But one day his life changes when he meets Coralina, the beautiful dancer who comes to town with a French opera company and with whom he flees the town to marry. But one day, after each one has formalized their relationship, fate unites Rosa and Alejandro. Together they know love. From this moment on, all the conflicts that will confront the cities of Santa Cruz de Mompos and Nuestra Señora de La Candelaria del Banco appear, and separate the protagonists.
title: Momposina

overview: Set in the Leimert Park section of Los Angeles, Moesha follows the life of a happy-go-lucky family through the eyes of a typical teenage girl. Her father, Frank, a Saturn car salesman, has remarried Dee, a teacher at her school, much to Moesha's dismay. As Dee makes real headway becoming a mother to Moesha's little brother, Myles, Moesha's fond memories of her real mother have inhibited her from opening up completely to Dee.
title: Moesha
